title: Feral (bear) druid: holds three mobs on itself against a DPS player

rules.desc: At most 40 percent of the mob damage events (hits counted, not amounts) land on the healer or the DPS player; the rest on the bear
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:211-226 (loose adds near -> challenging roar at INTERRUPT + 2, melee medium aoe -> demoralizing roar and swipe); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:351-396 (LooseAddsNearTrigger, ShouldAoeTaunt); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: three mobs at -2, one 10 s growl cooldown, the roar and the swipe rows carry the spread; whether the outcome holds under a geared DPS player is the question. Expected UNKNOWN at abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently at abb91ff62.
